description:
The LATEST TRADED PRICE today for US stocks / ETFs — a DELAYED intraday quote (typically ~15 minutes behind),
    with today's change vs the previous close. Use it when the user asks about TODAY during the US session ("why is
    UBER down today", "where is NVDA trading"): every other price tool is END-OF-DAY (last close). US listings only —
    any other market returns `not_covered` (use stock_prices). Pair the move with today's news (stock_impact /
    search_news) for the why. State the quote time and that it is delayed; it is not a live tick.

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — paste the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language: 'ขอราคาผลไม้ apple', 'compare Apple and Microsoft stock'). The server uses it to disambiguate which candidate each `ticker` entity means (the apple COMPANY vs the fruit COMMODITY; which Samsung). One context per call, shared by all tickers here.
